Here are refined **bridal package options** for *A Prestige Aesthetics*, built from her existing services (Botox, filler, AgeJet, microneedling with PRP, facials, peels, LED, IV therapy, peptides, and wellness). Pricing reflects Tennessee med spa market averages and can be adjusted based on local competition or promotional goals.  

---

## Bridal Glow Package  
**Ideal Start:** 3–6 months before the wedding  
**Price:** $1,450  

**Includes:**  
- Custom Facial with LED Therapy (2 sessions)  
- Light to Medium Chemical Peel (2 sessions)  
- Microneedling with PRP (1 session)  
- Botox (up to 40 units) – scheduled 8–10 weeks before wedding  
- IV Hydration Therapy (1 session before wedding)  
- Personalized Bridal Skincare Regimen with at-home products  

**Optional Add-ons:**  
- Filler Touch-Up (per syringe) – $650–$850  
- Bridal Party Facials – $120 per person  
- Day-Before Calming LED Session – $95  

**Purpose:**  
Designed to even skin tone, reduce fine lines, and achieve a radiant glow for photography and close-up confidence.

---

## Bridal Radiance Package  
**Ideal Start:** 6–9 months before the wedding  
**Price:** $3,250  

**Includes:**  
- Advanced AgeJet Laser or Skin Tightening Treatment (1 full session)  
- Microneedling with PRP (2 sessions, spaced 6–8 weeks apart)  
- Custom Facial Series with LED Therapy (3 sessions)  
- Medium to Deep Chemical Peel (1–2 sessions)  
- Botox (up to 50 units) with touch-up before wedding  
- Filler (1 syringe included)  
- IV Therapy (2 sessions, mid-series and week before wedding)  
- Personalized Skincare Kit (cleanser, serum, sunscreen, post-procedure balm)  
- Day-Before Express Facial or LED Recovery Session  

**Optional Add-ons:**  
- Additional Filler (per syringe) – $700  
- Peptide Consultation and Starter Kit – $295  
- Bridal Party Glow Package – $300 per person (includes facial and light peel)

**Purpose:**  
This full-spectrum program addresses skin texture, tone, and elasticity over time, combining advanced treatments and wellness support to create long-lasting results and a flawless complexion for the big day.

---

## Express Bridal Boost  
**Ideal Start:** 2–4 weeks before the wedding  
**Price:** $695  

**Includes:**  
- Custom Facial with LED Therapy  
- Light Chemical Peel or Microdermabrasion  
- Botox Touch-Up (up to 20 units)  
- IV Hydration + Vitamin C Boost (within 48 hours before wedding)  
- Gentle Post-Treatment Skincare Mini Kit  

**Optional Add-ons:**  
- Additional Botox Units – $12/unit  
- Calming Oxygen Facial (Day Before) – $95  

**Purpose:**  
A fast, safe skin-perfecting solution for brides needing immediate radiance and hydration, perfect for short timelines or destination weddings.

---

## Bridal Party Add-On Packages  
**Available with any bridal package**  

**Bridal Party Glow (per person):** $275  
Includes a custom facial, LED brightening session, and mini skincare kit.  

**Mother of the Bride/Groom Refresh:** $450  
Includes light peel, Botox (20 units), and custom facial with LED.  

---

Here are a few bridal / “wedding glow” package ideas based on the services offered by A Prestige Aesthetics (Botox / injectables, AgeJet Laser, chemical peels, custom facials, microneedling, PRP, LED therapy, IV therapy, wellness / peptides, etc.). You can mix & match, also price tiers (Silver, Gold, Platinum) or time-before-wedding (6 months, 3 months, 1 month). Feel free to adjust based on operational capacity, cost, and desired margins.

---

## Key principles & structure

- Bridal clients often start planning skin prep many months in advance. Offer “pre-wedding timeline” suggestions (e.g. start 6 months out)  
- Include a “touch-up / maintenance” element closer to wedding day  
- Add “wellness boost” (IV, peptides) as optional add-ons  
- Offer “bridal party” / “mother of bride/groom” mini versions  
- Bundle with a small discount vs à la carte  

---

## Sample Bridal Packages

Below are two example packages (mid-tier and premium), plus a “fast fix” add-on for last-minute brides.

---

### ✨ Bridal Glow Package (Mid Tier)

**Time frame recommended**: Start ~4–6 months before wedding (but can be scaled shorter)

**What’s included:**

| Service | Timing / notes |
|---|---|
| Custom facial + LED therapy | 1 session every ~4–6 weeks |
| Chemical peel (light to medium) | 2 sessions (e.g. at ~5 months and ~2 months before) |
| Microneedling (or PRP option) | 1 session ~3 months before |
| Botox / anti-wrinkle injections | 1 session ~8–12 weeks before (for relaxing lines) |
| Touch-up filler / minor injectable (optional) | ~4 weeks before wedding |
| Wellness boost: IV therapy or peptide therapy | 1 session ~1 month before to enhance glow and hydration |
| Skin care plan + product kit | Provide a bridal skincare regimen to use leading up to the day |

**Extras / Add-ons (not mandatory)**

- LED therapy sessions closer to wedding day  
- A “day-of” express treatment (gentle facial, lymphatic massage)  
- Add a bridal party facial discount  

---

### 💎 Bridal Radiance Premium Package

**Time frame recommended**: 6+ months lead time

**What’s included:**

| Service | Frequency / schedule |
|---|---|
| Deep custom facials + LED therapy | 3–4 sessions (e.g. months 6, 4, 2, 1) |
| Medium chemical peels / advanced peel | 2–3 sessions spaced out |
| Microneedling + PRP combo | 1 or 2 sessions (e.g. ~4 months & ~2 months out) |
| AgeJet laser / skin tightening | 1–2 sessions (to firm / smooth) |
| Botox / anti-wrinkle injections | 2 sessions (one earlier, one touch-up) |
| Filler / volumizing injectable as needed | 1 session ~8 weeks out |
| Wellness / IV + peptide therapy | 2 sessions (mid-course + ~1 month before) |
| “Day-of” express facial + LED / calming therapy | The morning of or day before |
| Bridal skincare kit & ongoing regimen | Premium grade products + detailed plan |
| Bridal party add-on discount | Option for bridal party for a reduced rate |

---

### ⏳ Last-Minute / Express Bridal Boost

For brides who are closer to their wedding and want a fast “glow boost”:

- Custom facial + LED therapy (within 1–2 weeks before)  
- Light chemical peel (if safe)  
- Botox / anti-wrinkle small injections (if possible)  
- IV hydration / nutrients day before  
- “Day-of” express facial or calming/soothing mask  
- Gift small skincare kit for maintenance post-wedding  

---

## Suggested Pricing & Tiering Ideas

- **Glow (entry / mid)**: covers basic facial, peel, injectables, wellness — moderate price  
- **Radiance / Premium**: all advanced services, multiple sessions, “day-of” extras — top tier  
- **À la carte “bridal booster”**: shorter-term modules or single treatments  

You could also include a tiered discount: e.g. upgrade from Glow → Radiance gives 10–15 % discount vs buying all services separately.

---
